# x402-skill-md

> The skill.md toolkit: generate and validate agent-discoverable skill files (the agentres.dev pattern) from OpenAPI specs. Defines the SKILL-MD format used across the x402 Suite.

x402-skill-md is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/x402-skill-md/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference
